name: Compose smoke retry
command:
set -euo pipefail
email=$(awk -F= '/^BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=/{print substr($0,index($0,"=")+1)}' backend/.env | tr -d '"' | tail -1)
password=$(awk -F= '/^BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=/{print substr($0,index($0,"=")+1)}' backend/.env | tr -d '"' | tail -1)
[ -n "$email" ] && [ -n "$password" ]
cookie=$(mktemp); login_body=$(mktemp); me_body=$(mktemp); chat_body=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$cookie" "$login_body" "$me_body" "$chat_body"' EXIT
login_status=$(curl -sS -o "$login_body" -w '%{http_code}' -c "$cookie" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$(printf '{"email":"%s","password":"%s"}' "$email" "$password")" http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/User/login)
me_status=$(curl -sS -o "$me_body" -w '%{http_code}' -b "$cookie" http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/User/me)
health_status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -b "$cookie" http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/agent/health)
chat_status=$(curl -sS -o "$chat_body" -w '%{http_code}' -b "$cookie" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message":"Qual é a política de check-in?"}' http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/agent/chat)
node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const me=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); const chat=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],"utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({login_status:process.argv[3],me_status:process.argv[4],agent_health_status:process.argv[5],chat_status:process.argv[6],role:me.role,agent_action:chat.action?.type ?? chat.action ?? null}))' "$me_body" "$chat_body" "$login_status" "$me_status" "$health_status" "$chat_status"
description: Retry live authenticated admin login and agent gateway smoke with the configured bootstrap credential names.
